an6.53:1.1: aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an6.53:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.53:2.1: atthi nukho bho gotama eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyikoti
an6.53:2.2: atthi kho brāhmaṇa eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyikoti
an6.53:3.1: katamo pana bho gotama eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyikoti
an6.53:3.2: appamādo kho brāhmaṇa eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyiko
an6.53:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena
an6.53:4.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyiko
an6.53:5.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭaṃ tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati
an6.53:6.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti nidhunāti nicchādeti
an6.53:7.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭopanibandhanāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti
an6.53:8.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa ye keci khuddakarājāno sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā bhavanti rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggamakkhāyati
an6.53:9.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā sabbā tā candassa pabhāya kallaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ candappabhā tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati
an6.53:9.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyiko
an6.53:10.1: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ yo ca attho samparāyikoti.
an6.53:11.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe…
an6.53:11.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti. 54
